title: Feature Lottery? A Bifurcation Theory of Concept Emergence
abstract: arXiv:2605.24057v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neural networks learn structured representations at specific points during training, yet pinpointing these transitions usually requires post-hoc, label-dependent metrics. We introduce a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics to detect these moments in real time. By analyzing a passive GMM probe on an evolving encoder, we show that the emergence of structure corresponds to a supercritical pitchfork bifurcation driven by the loss Hessian. Comparing a theoretically predictable zero-crossing ($\beta_c$) with the network's current state ($\beta$) yields a dynamic ratio, $\beta(t)/\beta_c(t)$. Computed solely from hidden states, this ratio is a universal, label-free phase coordinate for representation dynamics. We validate the four transition regimes this coordinate predicts across diverse settings: sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on language models (Pythia), self-supervised learning (CIFAR), and grokking (modular arithmetic). translated_title: 特征彩票？概念涌现的分岔理论
translated_abstract: 神经网络在训练过程中的特定时点会学习到结构化表示，然而精确定位这些转变通常需要事后的、依赖标签的度量指标。我们引入了一种表示动力学的分岔理论，以实时检测这些关键时刻。通过分析演化中编码器上的被动GMM探针，我们证明了结构的涌现对应于由损失Hessian矩阵驱动的超临界叉式分岔。将理论上可预测的过零点（β_c）与网络当前状态（β）进行比较，可得到一个动态比值 β(t)/β_c(t)。该比值仅由隐藏状态计算得出，是表示动力学的通用、无标签的相位坐标。我们在多种设置中验证了该坐标所预测的四种转变状态：语言模型（Pythia）上的稀疏自编码器（SAE）、自监督学习（CIFAR）以及grokking（模运算）现象。
tldr: 提出了一种基于分岔理论的表示动力学框架，利用仅从隐藏状态计算得到的无标签相位坐标 β(t)/β_c(t)，可实时检测神经网络中结构化表示的涌现时刻，并在稀疏自编码器、自监督学习和grokking等多种场景中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a bifurcation theory of representation dynamics, where a universal label-free phase coordinate β(t)/β_c(t) computed solely from hidden states detects in real time when structured representations emerge in neural networks, validated across sparse autoencoders, self-supervised learning, and grokking.
